description: Cook Islands Building Polygons (Topo, 1:25k, Zone3 (series on LINZ Data Service) is a series of datasets listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Topographic Office. A relatively permanent walled and roofed construction. Data Dictionary for buildingpoly: topo. linz. govt. nz/data-dictionary/tdd-class-buildingpoly. html This layer is a component of the Topo50 map series. The Topo50 map series provides topographic mapping for New Zealand and it's offshore dependancies, at 1:50,000. For some small islands the printed map scale is 1:25,000. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher National Topographic Office. Its tags are New Zealand. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2022-06-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
